context.observed: Only NPC-visible facts, retrieved memories and current goals

notes: This file is a contract guide with examples, not a machine JSON Schema or a ready qualification manifest.
Canonical JSON uses sorted keys, UTF-8, no whitespace, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False.
Case contentHash never includes labels, split or reviewer output. Model text never includes candidate IDs/positions/labels.
All case/review/adjudication ID sets must agree. Cases in a qualified manifest must all be supported; keep ambiguous/rejected records in the separate source archive.
Source groups and template families cannot cross any of train/dev/calT/select/cert/test. Fixed open-train floor is 512/128, not the final 4096 target.
Review session sets A and B cannot intersect. Different names in one actual session are not independent reviews.
Qualification validates binding/structure; honest original provenance and actual independent review cannot be created by changing flags.
